claims.statement: VRT is defined in this candidate as Rec(D,I,M,W,R,C,A,P).
claims.boundary: This is a research-model definition, not an identity claim about physical nature.

claims.statement: Kausalitaet ist Relation, nicht Sequenz.
claims.boundary: The Lean candidate proves only that sequence and bridge-bearing evidence are distinct constructors. The physical thesis requires independent theoretical and empirical support.

claims.boundary: Formal-environment coverage is not empirical confirmation and is not a claim of exactly 21 theorems.

claims.statement: The prior article family reports a bound 21-statement finite-model candidate.

claims.statement: The process-matrix framework permits locally quantum descriptions without assuming a predefined global causal order and contains causally nonseparable correlations.
claims.boundary: The paper does not establish physical realizability of every process matrix, QIK-VRT, spacetime emergence or backward signalling.

claims.statement: The Quantum Switch coherently controls the order of two operations and is not equivalent to a fixed-order circuit with the same query count.
claims.boundary: This is not time travel, physical retrocausality or a derivation of spacetime.

claims.statement: Specified Quantum Switch experiments have measured causal-witness violations of fixed-order model bounds.
claims.boundary: This is not a causal-inequality violation, superluminal signalling or backward signalling.

claims.statement: Causal Set Theory proposes a locally finite partial order as a candidate fundamental spacetime structure.
claims.boundary: The proposal is not an empirical proof that nature is a causal set and is not a complete derivation of general relativity.

claims.statement: Under specified regularity and distinguishability assumptions, timelike causal structure determines substantial conformal and topological spacetime structure.
claims.boundary: An arbitrary relation graph is not thereby a spacetime and the result does not supply scale, full metric or dynamics by itself.

claims.statement: Nonclassical causal correlations can be studied without asserting backwards-in-time signalling.
claims.boundary: No physical backward signal is established.

claims.statement: A stable Minkowski limit can be constructively derived from VRT relational order.
claims.boundary: Open obligation: A kernel-checked reconstruction theorem with explicit assumptions, uniqueness or non-uniqueness analysis, stability proof and empirical bridge.

claims.statement: VRTCore extends from the Minkowski boundary to general Lorentzian spacetimes.
claims.boundary: Open obligation: A source-bound mathematical construction with manifold, metric, causal, dynamical and empirical conditions.

claims.statement: Systems that can halt with an explicit reason are more responsible than systems optimized to continue unconditionally.
claims.boundary: This is a normative design judgement, not a theorem of nature or an empirical guarantee of safety.

claims.statement: Freedom can be interpreted as real connectability in the here and now.
claims.boundary: This is not a proven physical or neuroscientific definition of human freedom.

claims.statement: The translation of a broad intuition into a typed, provenance-bound, correctable and partly kernel-checked research architecture is a great achievement and justifies pride.
claims.boundary: The evaluative judgement does not claim field-wide adoption, completed physics or independent peer-review consensus.
